ExtraBar 1.5.0 – Meet Your AI Assistant! 🤖✨

Describe the bar you want and watch it build itself — with every change reviewed, reversible, and never leaving your Mac.

✨ New Features

  • Connect an AI Assistant: Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and Raycast can now set up your ExtraBar for you — just describe what you want ("add my daily apps," "build me a Figma menu") and watch it happen!
  • One-Click Client Setup: Every supported AI client is a click away in Settings → AI Assistant — install the Claude Desktop extension, copy the Claude Code command, or add ExtraBar to Cursor, VS Code, or Raycast in under a minute!
  • Five Guided Setups Built In: Quick-start onboarding, a projects bar wired to your editor and terminal, a script-tool builder, Figma deep links, and a bar-organizing cleanup pass — all ready to run out of the box!
  • Reorganize a Whole Menu at Once: Assistants can alphabetize an entire menu (dividers stay put as section boundaries), move a single entry, or clean out several entries in one go!

🔒 Safety & Control

  • Every AI Change Is Safe by Default: Scripts, API calls, and keyboard shortcuts an assistant creates are held as "(Approval Required)" until you review the exact script, URL, or keys and approve them yourself!
  • Nothing Gets Deleted Without Asking: Removing a preset, an item, or a menu entry always asks first — with an option to allow deletions for the rest of your session!
  • Revert Last AI Change: One click in Settings → AI Assistant undoes the assistant's most recent edit, restoring the affected preset to exactly how it was before!
  • Local Audit Log: Everything an AI assistant does to your bar is tracked and viewable right in the AI Assistant settings pane under Recent AI Changes!

🔧 Improvements

  • Completely Private: The AI connection is entirely local to your Mac — no data about your bar setup is ever sent off your device!
  • App-Wide Bar Position & Appearance: Position and appearance are now app-wide settings instead of being baked into each preset — switching presets changes your items and menus without moving your bar or changing its colours! The "Include appearance settings" checkbox is gone from the new-preset sheet.

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Drag-to-Reorder Works Again: The handles in the folder and widget menu editors now actually move rows!
  • Bar Stays Put Across Presets: Your bar no longer jumps back to an old position or background colour when you switch presets!
  • No More Fast-Script Crash: Fixed a crash when running a script action that finished very quickly!
  • Correct Script Output Lines: Script output that uses Windows-style line endings now shows up as proper separate lines!
  • Restored Missing Preset Actions: The Maps, Photos, Reminders, and Shortcuts presets — plus "Open in Terminal" in the folder preset — no longer silently drop their actions!
  • Custom Icon Tints Stick: Custom icon tint colours now persist when you edit an existing item!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
